$comment: Two failures with different recoveries. A declined payment stays on the same request in payment_pending until it expires; an expired one returns the request to agreed (job machine transition 9) so the customer may start payment again at the same agreed price. Neither is an error the customer caused.
note: A client never confirms its own payment. public.confirm_payment has no grant to any client role and 29_payments_test asserts it. The app starts the payment, opens the checkout URL, and waits for the request status to change.
